name: B4C
notes: Phase reference: Clark and Hoard, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 65, 2115-2119 (1943), doi:10.1021/ja01251a026; JCPDS/PDF 6-0555. Average R-3m B4C model: the polar icosahedral site is represented by split B/C occupancy; the reference cell is constrained to the EoS V0 while retaining the measured axial ratio.

eos_records.notes: Quasi-hydrostatic room-temperature fit to 50 GPa. The average disordered R-3m structure follows the ideal B4C model confirmed to 74 GPa by Dera et al., J. Solid State Chem. 215, 85-93 (2014), doi:10.1016/j.jssc.2014.03.018.
